Chapter 972  Chapter 27 The New Supreme (Please Subscribe)_2

Although the Robber Clan did not participate in the siege against the Galaxy Master, and even sent warning signals to him, by rights they should be credited for their actions.

However, if they become complacent about their merits and do not make any concessions, it could potentially displease the Galaxy Master, which would lead to trouble.

The two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan naturally do not wish to take this risk; they have means to survive this Cosmic Era and have no need to worry about the gains and losses of a single Cosmic Era.

Moreover, the Robber Clan has a sparse population, so even if they reduce their territory by ninety percent, it would still be more than sufficient, with no significant impact.

...

Thunderous roars.

Lin Yuan took a few steps and reached the banks of the River of Time.

"Is this what it feels like to be on the shore?" Lin Yuan looked around, and at this moment, dozens of twelfth-layer ultimates were staying as far away from him as possible.

"All such little figures." Lin Yuan, overlooking all beneath him, glimpsed down at the twelfth-layer ultimates who only reached up to his knees.

"My life essence indeed surpasses the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm." Lin Yuan also glanced at the two ultimates of the Robber Clan, estimating in his heart.

In terms of combat power, he had completely reached the realm of a ruler, but his state was still in the Path Splitting Realm, with his life essence also surpassing the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.

"I must not be arrogant. Within this universe, I am indeed at the highest position, but what about in Ancient Ming's Chaos Continent? In the Chaos Void? I still have a long way to go."

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts, having a clear understanding of himself.

He has a permanent incarnation in Ancient Ming's Chaos Continent, having once observed the River of Time in the Chaos Void.

The River of Time in the Chaos Void is the main river, vastly more immense than the countless branches of the River of Time in the universe; towering along its banks are awe-inspiring figures.

Many of these figures are as tall as the heavens and earth, and a slight movement is enough to affect the main stream of the River of Time.

"The Chaos Void is the source of the evolutionary path, the high goals of the many Chaos Venerables and even Great Saints, which far transcend what life within the universe could compare."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

Countless universes have been born in the Chaos Void, and compared to the harsh Chaos Void, the universe is more like a cradle, protecting the twelfth-layer beings from harm.

Although, the Big Crunch of the universe means a death rate of over fifty percent for twelfth-layer beings.

But in the Chaos Void? The death rate for twelfth-layer Path Splitting Realm beings is much higher than fifty percent. For the passing ruler-level Chaos Realm beings, or some unknown dangerous places, they all pose danger for twelfth-layer Path Splitting Realm beings.

Even 'Cang Weiyang', a peak ruler, had fallen at the Taiyuan Relic, let alone those in the Path Splitting Realm.

In the Chaos Void, only Chaos Realm beings dare say they are hard to kill; those below the Chaos Realm face many dangers without the capability to protect themselves.

"The aura by the bank..."

Lin Yuan looked in all directions. Having successfully reached the shore, his life essence of the twelfth-layer level greatly enhanced his senses.

With the special environment at the banks of the River of Time allowing him to settle down briefly, Lin Yuan once again entered a state of enlightenment.

[Your Against-Heaven's Understanding is sensing the environment around you, deciphering the Great Tao of Life...]

...

[Your Against-Heaven's Understanding is sensing the environment around you, deciphering the Great Tao of Matter...]

...

[Your Against-Heaven's Understanding is sensing the environment around you, deciphering the Great Tao of Cause and Effect...]

...

[Your Against-Heaven's Understanding is sensing the environment around you, deepening your understanding of Space-Time...]

...

[Your Against-Heaven's Understanding is sensing the environment around you, deepening your understanding of Chaos...]

...

In an instant, Lin Yuan's mind was flooded with unprecedented inspiration; various fundamental rules were transforming into the level of the Great Tao.

The Great Tao, rising above the rules of the same level. While Lin Yuan contemplated the Chaos Rules, he incidentally deciphered some Great Tao, but altogether, they numbered only a few dozen.

But at this moment, having just stepped into the twelfth-layer not long ago, he had already deciphered hundreds of Great Dao, the transformation of life level not only elevated Lin Yuan's perspective but also terrifyingly boosted his Against-Heaven's Understanding.

"Space-Time Seventh Realm..." Lin Yuan was rapidly advancing in his understanding of space-time.

If Lin Yuan were only within the cosmos, even if he advanced to the Twelfth Layer, and even with his Against-Heaven's Understanding, his perception of time and space wouldn't have improved so rapidly.

However, with an incarnation always residing in the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming, he can constantly observe the time and space of the Chaos Void, where time and space are more complete and profound, offering greater help to Lin Yuan.

"And the Chaos Rule..." Lin Yuan's thoughts wandered, his gaze faintly piercing through cosmic barriers, gazing into the Chaos Void.

As the fundamental rule of all things, the complexity and obscurity of the Chaos Rule are imaginable.

Normally, only the Chaos Venerable are qualified to delve deeply into the Chaos Rule, but Lin Yuan's exceptional insight has already begun to gradually grasp the essence of the Chaos Rule.

At the Eleventh Layer, it was already Lin Yuan's limit to comprehend the Chaos Rule, and he couldn't delve deeper. But now, transcending life levels, Lin Yuan sees more mysterious aspects of chaos.

...

The ultimate endeavor of Lin Yuan has a tremendous impact on human civilization and the Starry Sky Races, attracting the attention of countless strong beings.

Once the Xuanyuan Supreme and other nine supremes return, the news that the Galaxy Master successfully advanced to the Twelfth Layer will be officially announced.

Suddenly.

Human civilization is boiling with excitement.

"The Galaxy Master has advanced to the Twelfth Layer, hahaha, after two million years, our human civilization finally has the tenth supreme being."

"The Galaxy Master is not just a supreme being, but more."

"The Galaxy Master is too powerful."

...

Countless evolvers and citizens of human civilization are excitedly discussing how the emergence of one more supreme being will have an unparalleled and profound impact on the entire human civilization.

"Did I, Chikun, teach a supreme being?" Chikun Star Lord, looking at the many congratulatory emails coming his way, had numerous thoughts in his mind and felt unreal as if floating in ecstasy."

Although Chikun Star Lord had long known that the Galaxy Master had a great chance of becoming a supreme being, the arrival of this day still felt incredibly surreal.

Not long ago, Chikun Star Lord felt the fluctuations of time and space and was incredibly worried, deeply fearing some accident in Lin Yuan's ultimate challenge.

Now that the dust has settled, Chikun Star Lord wondered if he was dreaming.

"The little junior brother became a supreme being?"

The Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage nearby had mixed feelings. Had that tender junior brother from before become a supreme being who now overlooks the Cosmic Starry Skies?

"Never address him that way in the future." The Great Peak Master seemed to realize something, looking towards the many Peak Masters and warned.

"Understood."

The Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage were startled and immediately nodded in agreement.

Unlike Chikun Star Lord, as the senior brothers of the Red Kun Lineage, they had no substantial help for Lin Yuan, and calling him "little junior brother" was somewhat presumptuous.

Human civilization itself respects the strong, and those who come later reside atop the former. Titles naturally need to change. Lin Yuan has a good temper, and when he advanced through the Eighth, Ninth, Tenth, and Eleventh Layers, he allowed the Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage to address each other as before.

But now, as Galaxy Master ascends to the Twelfth Layer and becomes a supreme being, even if he is willing to let them maintain the old titles, the Peak Masters dare not do so.

...

In the depths of the Starry Sky.

Inside a secret realm.

The giant Maduo Traveler was filled with excitement, looking at the nearby sitting Sizhong Ancient God, spoke excitedly: "Ancestor, your foresight is truly extraordinary, initially advising me not to offend the Galaxy Master. Now, it appears to be the right decision."

Maduo Traveler felt immensely grateful. Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he had a conflict with the Galaxy Master.

Later, under the command of his own ancestor and at the risk of offending the Tianyu Clan, he made efforts to befriend the Galaxy Master.

Now, looking back, how wise was that decision?

Maduo Traveler could already imagine, if he hadn't mended his relationship with the Galaxy Master back then, how fearful he would be hearing about the Galaxy Master's advancement to the Twelfth Layer now.

"As for my foresight, there's naturally no need to boast..." Sizhong Ancient God steadied himself, suppressed the shock in his heart, and barely managed to speak calmly.

Indeed, Sizhong Ancient God's shock was no less than that of Maduo Traveler; he indeed predicted that the Galaxy Master had the potential to advance to the Twelfth Layer, but never expected it would happen so swiftly.

...

In the year 2,609,782 of the Starry Sea Era, the human civilization gave birth to its tenth supreme being.
